dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Extra, extra! The legendary bandit, the Phantom Weasel, has reemerged after over a decade of silence! A letter has been sent, a challenge delivered at the Opera Epiclese — one has to ask, who sent it?

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Watch your treasures, O ye wealthy. Guard your children, honest citizens! The Weasel has returned!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Beep-boop! Would you like to know more about the Weasel's curious case? Follow The Steambird's exclusive interview!
